dataset_role: AI-reviewed development set; not held-out or human-adjudicated evidence

metric_definitions.hit_rate_at_5: fraction of queries with at least one relevant passage in original first five positions
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_5: binary gains discounted by 1/log2(rank+1), divided by ideal gain for min(5, gold count)
metric_definitions.precision_at_5: unique relevant hits in original first five positions / 5; missing positions get zero
metric_definitions.recall_at_5: unique relevant hits in original first five positions / all gold passages

threshold_origin: Predeclared project development nDCG@5 target, not an IIT-mandated threshold. The previous 0.70 raw Recall@5 target is retired as unattainable for these exhaustive labels.
timing_note: Models/index loaded once before evaluation. Latencies include query inference and search, not startup.
